blocks.text: In Zscaler Cellular Anomaly Detection, you can configure the Geofence Anomaly Detection Policy. This policy allows administrators to define and manage rules that detect anomalies based on SIM Location Groups. It is designed to monitor device activity within a specified geofence area, and when a device moves outside its assigned boundary, the system triggers an anomaly.
To learn more, see Understanding Anomaly Detection.
Before configuring an anomaly detection policy, create SIM Location Groups.

blocks.heading: Configuring a Geofence Anomaly Detection Policy

blocks.text: To add a new anomaly detection policy:

blocks.item: From the navigation menu, go to Infrastructure > Cellular > Anomaly Dashboard.
Select the checkbox next to the SIM Group Name and click the SIM Group Name to add it to your policy.
Rule Name: Enter the name of the rule.
Add Description (Optional): Enter a description of the rule.
Rule Status: Enable or disable the status.
In the Group Details tab, you can see a map view with the geofencing details, device status, and assigned policy details, including anomaly type and current status.
Geofencing is the only policy type currently available.
You are redirected to the Anomaly Dashboard. In the Enabled column, click the Enable toggle to run the policy.
